desc:
PROTEIN BARS: Delicious chewy protein bars featuring caramel and nuts and coated in chocolate with six grams of protein per serving, along with two grams of sugar, and five grams of net carbs

HEALTHY FIBER SNACKS: Protein bars that help fill you up as part of a balanced diet; Contain at least 20% of the daily value of fiber so you'll feel like one smart cookie when you say 'yes' to your sweet tooth

CARAMEL NUT: Don’t compromise on great taste when you can enjoy the irresistible taste of caramel, peanuts, and chocolate in these Fiber One Chewy Protein Bars

PANTRY AND LUNCH BOX FAVORITE: Grab and go chewy fiber bars for an office snack, breakfast, the lunch box, dessert, or an on-the-go invigorating treat

CONTAINS: 10 ct (Pack of 6)
features:
Key Features:

Delicious Caramel & Nut Flavor

Combines roasted peanuts and chewy caramel with a light chocolatey coating for a sweet and salty taste experience.

High Fiber Content

Each bar contains about 6 to 8 grams of fiber, helping support digestive health and fullness.

Good Source of Protein

Delivers 6 to 7 grams of protein per bar, making it a satisfying snack between meals or post-workout.

Low Sugar & Net Carbs

With only 2 grams of sugar and approximately 5 grams of net carbs, it’s suitable for lower-sugar lifestyles.

Portion-Controlled and Convenient:

Individually wrapped and sized for easy, on-the-go snacking without overindulging.

Benefits:

Supports Digestive Health

High fiber promotes regularity and helps you feel full longer, making it easier to manage hunger.

Curbs Cravings Smartly

Satisfies sweet and salty cravings without the sugar spike of candy bars or pastries.

Helps with Muscle Maintenance

The protein content supports satiety and can aid in muscle recovery after light workouts.

Better-for-You Snack Option

Lower in sugar and calories compared to traditional snack bars, while still offering great taste.

Perfect for Busy Lifestyles

No prep needed—just toss one in your bag, lunchbox, or gym kit and you’re set.
ingredients: Chicory Root Extract, Roasted Peanuts, Soy Protein Isolate, Palm Kernel and Palm Oil, Soluble Corn Fiber, Whey Protein Concentrate, Allulose, Rice Flour, Vegetable Glycerin, Invert Sugar, Corn Syrup, Cocoa Powder, Rice Starch, Cocoa Processed With Alkali, Soy Lecithin, Milk Protein Isolate, Salt, Corn Starch, Canola Oil, Natural Flavor, Sugar, Stevia Leaf Extract, Carrageenan, Disodium Phosphate, Barley Malt Extract, Caramel Color, Mixed Tocopherols Added to Retain Freshness.
